ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Weather.source:
type Row = {
	name: string,

	seconds: number,
	active: boolean,
}

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Config)

local NONE = 1

local Weather = {}

function Weather.now(): number
	return Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
end

function Weather.slotAt(seconds: number): number
	return math.floor(seconds / Config.Weather.everySeconds)
end

function Weather.startOf(slot: number): number
	return slot * Config.Weather.everySeconds
end

function Weather.nameAt(slot: number): string
	local Order = Config.Weather.Order

	return Order[slot % #Order + 1]
end

function Weather.running(): string?
	local now = Weather.now()
	local slot = Weather.slotAt(now)

	if now - Weather.startOf(slot) >= Config.Weather.liveSeconds then return nil end

	return Weather.nameAt(slot)
end

function Weather.row(name: string?): any?
	if not name then return nil end

	return Config.Weather.Events[name]
end

local function payout(field: string): number
	local row = Weather.row(Weather.running())
	if not row then return NONE end

	local worth = row[field]

	return if type(worth) == "number" then worth else NONE
end

function Weather.speedPayout(): number
	return payout("speed")
end

function Weather.winsPayout(): number
	return payout("wins")
end

function Weather.board(): {Row}
	local now = Weather.now()
	local slot = Weather.slotAt(now)
	local running = Weather.running()

	local first = if running then slot else slot + 1

	local Rows: {Row} = {}

	for step = 0, #Config.Weather.Order - 1 do
		local at = first + step

		if step == 0 and running then
			table.insert(Rows, {
				name = running,
				seconds = math.max(Weather.startOf(at) + Config.Weather.liveSeconds - now, 0),
				active = true,
			})
			continue
		end

		table.insert(Rows, {
			name = Weather.nameAt(at),
			seconds = math.max(Weather.startOf(at) - now, 0),
			active = false,
		})
	end

	return Rows
end

return Weather

StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.Servi.source:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Janitor)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Config)
local Weather = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Weather)

local NotifyClient = require(script.Parent.NotifyClient)

local GUI_NAME = "ScreenGui"
local FLASH_NAME = "WeatherFlash"
local ZOOM_NAME = "WeatherZoom"
local TITLE_NAME = "Title"
local ICON_NAME = "Icon"
local BUTTON_NAME = "Button"
local WAIT_TIMEOUT = 10
local MINUTE = 60

local ZOOM_PRIORITY = Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2

local MAX_FIELD = 120

local ZOOM_STYLE = Enum.EasingStyle.Quint
local ZOOM_DIRECTION = Enum.EasingDirection.Out

local HOVER_NAME = "BoostHover"
local NAME_NAME = "Name"
local DESCRIPTION_NAME = "Description"
local TEXT_NAME = "Text"

local ENTRY_INDEX = "entry"
local ENTER_INDEX = "enter"
local LEAVE_INDEX = "leave"

local PRESET_CLASSES = {
	Sky = true,
	Atmosphere = true,
	BloomEffect = true,
	ColorCorrectionEffect = true,
	SunRaysEffect = true,
}

local WeatherClient = {}

local janitor = Janitor.new()

local flashJanitor = Janitor.new()

local playerGui: Instance? = nil
local activeRoot: Instance? = nil
local entry: Instance? = nil

local applied: string? = nil

local settled = false

local flashToken = 0

local fieldBase: number? = nil

local zoomStart = 0
local zooming = false

local function setText(label: Instance?, text: string)
	if not (label and label:IsA("TextLabel")) then return end
	if label.Text == text then return end

	label.Text = text
end

local function findPath(root: Instance?, Path: {string}): Instance?
	local current: Instance? = root
	for _, name in ipairs(Path) do
		if not current then return nil end
		current = (current :: Instance):FindFirstChild(name)
	end

	return current
end

local function icons(): Instance?
	return findPath(ReplicatedStorage, Config.Weather.Icons)
end

local function wearIcon(label: Instance?, name: string)
	local folder = icons()
	local decal = if folder then folder:FindFirstChild(name) else nil

	if not (label and label:IsA("ImageLabel") and decal and decal:IsA("Decal")) then
		warn(`[WeatherClient] could not find {table.concat(Config.Weather.Icons, ".")}.{name}`)
		return
	end

	label.Image = decal.Texture
end

local function board(): Instance?
	local gui = findPath(Workspace, Config.Weather.Board)

	return if gui and gui:IsA("SurfaceGui") then gui else nil
end

local function drawBoard()
	local gui = board()
	if not gui then return end

	local settings = Config.Weather

	for index, row in ipairs(Weather.board()) do
		local label = gui:FindFirstChild(string.format(settings.rowFormat, index))
		if not (label and label:IsA("TextLabel")) then continue end

		local event = Weather.row(row.name)
		if not event then continue end

		local seconds = math.floor(row.seconds)
		local title = string.format(settings.nameFormat, event.color:ToHex(), row.name)

		setText(label, string.format(
			if row.active then settings.activeFormat else settings.waitFormat,
			title,
			seconds // MINUTE,
			seconds % MINUTE
		))
	end
end

local function applyLightning(name: string)
	local folder = findPath(ReplicatedStorage, Config.Weather.Lightning)
	local preset = if folder then folder:FindFirstChild(name) else nil

	if not preset then
		warn(`[WeatherClient] could not find {ReplicatedStorage:GetFullName()}.{table.concat(Config.Weather.Lightning, ".")}.{name}`)
		return
	end

	for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
		if not PRESET_CLASSES[child.ClassName] then continue end

		child:Destroy()
	end

	for _, child in ipairs(preset:GetChildren()) do
		child:Clone().Parent = Lighting
	end
end

local function zoom()
	local settings = Config.Weather

	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not (camera and settings.zoomField > 0) then return end

	if not fieldBase then
		fieldBase = camera.FieldOfView
	end

	zoomStart = os.clock()

	if zooming then return end

	zooming = true

	RunService:BindToRenderStep(ZOOM_NAME, ZOOM_PRIORITY, function()
		local current = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		local base = fieldBase

		local out = settings.flashInSeconds
		local back = settings.flashOutSeconds
		local elapsed = os.clock() - zoomStart

		if not (current and base) or elapsed >= out + back + settings.zoomSettleSeconds then
			if current and base then
				current.FieldOfView = base
			end

			RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(ZOOM_NAME)

			zooming = false
			fieldBase = nil

			return
		end

		local share = if elapsed < out then elapsed / out else math.min((elapsed - out) / back, 1)
		local eased = TweenService:GetValue(share, ZOOM_STYLE, ZOOM_DIRECTION)
		local alpha = if elapsed < out then eased else 1 - eased

		current.FieldOfView = math.min(base + settings.zoomField * alpha, MAX_FIELD)
	end)
end

local function flashInto(name: string)
	local root = playerGui
	if not root then return end

	local settings = Config.Weather

	flashToken += 1
	local token = flashToken

	flashJanitor:Cleanup()

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = FLASH_NAME
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true

	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = settings.flashOrder
	gui.Parent = root

	flashJanitor:Add(gui)

	local sheet = Instance.new("Frame")
	sheet.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	sheet.BackgroundColor3 = settings.flashColor
	sheet.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	sheet.BorderSizePixel = 0
	sheet.Parent = gui

	local rise = TweenService:Create(sheet, TweenInfo.new(settings.flashInSeconds), { BackgroundTransparency = 0 })
	flashJanitor:Add(rise, "Cancel")
	rise:Play()

	zoom()

	task.wait(settings.flashInSeconds)
	if flashToken ~= token then return end

	applyLightning(name)

	local fall = TweenService:Create(sheet, TweenInfo.new(settings.flashOutSeconds), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
	flashJanitor:Add(fall, "Cancel")
	fall:Play()

	task.wait(settings.flashOutSeconds)
	if flashToken ~= token then return end

	flashJanitor:Cleanup()
end

local function announce(name: string)
	local row = Weather.row(name)
	if not row then return end

	local settings = Config.Weather

	NotifyClient.push({
		{ text = string.format(settings.startFormat, name), from = row.from, to = row.to },
		{
			text = string.format(settings.effectFormat, row.description, settings.liveSeconds // MINUTE),
			from = row.from,
			to = row.to,
		},
	})
end

local function buildEntry(name: string)
	local root = activeRoot
	if not root then return end

	local settings = Config.Weather

	local row = Weather.row(name)
	if not row then return end

	local template = findPath(ReplicatedStorage, settings.Template)
	if not (template and template:IsA("GuiObject")) then
		warn(`[WeatherClient] could not find {ReplicatedStorage:GetFullName()}.{table.concat(settings.Template, ".")}`)
		return
	end

	local made = janitor:Add(template:Clone(), "Destroy", ENTRY_INDEX)
	made.Name = name

	wearIcon(made:FindFirstChild(ICON_NAME), row.icon)

	local card = made:FindFirstChild(HOVER_NAME)
	if card and card:IsA("GuiObject") then
		card.Visible = false

		setText(card:FindFirstChild(NAME_NAME), string.format(settings.cardFormat, name))

		local description = card:FindFirstChild(DESCRIPTION_NAME)
		if description then
			setText(description:FindFirstChild(TEXT_NAME), row.description)
			wearIcon(description:FindFirstChild(ICON_NAME), row.hoverIcon)
		end

		local button = made:FindFirstChild(BUTTON_NAME)
		if button and button:IsA("GuiButton") then
			janitor:Add(button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				card.Visible = true
			end), "Disconnect", ENTER_INDEX)

			janitor:Add(button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
				card.Visible = false
			end), "Disconnect", LEAVE_INDEX)
		end
	end

	made.Parent = root
	entry = made
end

local function clearEntry()
	entry = nil
	janitor:Remove(ENTRY_INDEX)
end

local function tick()
	local running = Weather.running()

	if not settled or running ~= applied then
		local first = not settled

		settled = true
		applied = running

		if not running then
			clearEntry()

			if first then
				applyLightning(Config.Weather.defaultLightning)
			else
				task.spawn(flashInto, Config.Weather.defaultLightning)
			end
		else
			buildEntry(running)

			if first then
				applyLightning(running)
			else
				announce(running)

				task.spawn(flashInto, running)
			end
		end
	end

	drawBoard()

	local made = entry
	if not made then return end

	local top = Weather.board()[1]
	if not (top and top.active) then return end

	local seconds = math.floor(top.seconds)

	setText(made:FindFirstChild(TITLE_NAME), string.format(Config.Weather.timerFormat, seconds // MINUTE, seconds % MINUTE))
end

local function bind(gui: Instance)
	janitor:Cleanup()

	activeRoot = nil
	entry = nil

	local root = gui:FindFirstChild(Config.Weather.activeFrame)
	if not (root and root:IsA("GuiObject")) then
		warn(`[WeatherClient] could not find {gui:GetFullName()}.{Config.Weather.activeFrame}`)
		return
	end

	activeRoot = root

	local running = Weather.running()
	if not running then return end

	buildEntry(running)
end

function WeatherClient.start()
	local found = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", WAIT_TIMEOUT)
	if not found then
		warn(`[WeatherClient] {Player.Name} has no PlayerGui`)
		return
	end

	playerGui = found

	local gui = found:WaitForChild(GUI_NAME, WAIT_TIMEOUT)
	if gui then
		bind(gui)
	else
		warn(`[WeatherClient] could not find {found:GetFullName()}.{GUI_NAME}`)
	end

	found.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child: Instance)
		if child.Name ~= GUI_NAME then return end

		bind(child)
	end)

	while true do
		tick()
		task.wait(Config.Weather.tickSeconds)
	end
end

return WeatherClient
